correctness.rationale: The ten minor evaluations were computed explicitly and found injective on all 1024 coefficient vectors. Every coefficient subspace has one RREF representative; exhaustive pivot/free-bit enumeration checked 53,743,987 four-spaces and 109,221,651 five-spaces, with sharp support minima 48 and 54 attained by explicit coefficient bases. All ten subspace totals matched Gaussian binomial counts, and a clean C++17 rerun of the complete certificate gave VERIFY_OK. Finite enumeration is exhaustive, not sampling.

originality.rationale: Direct primary full-text comparison with Datta and Ghorpade (2015) establishes that its theorems determine only r<=3 or r>=6 in this ten-dimensional parameter case. The missing r=4,5 are newly computed, with 28 and 1120 minimizing subcodes. The 2026 same-family manuscript describes one-word weights, not higher-dimensional common support in its available abstract, and published research searches did not show equivalent computations. The unavailable full text and unindexed literature remain named risks.
residual_risks: The 2026 same-family weight-spectrum preprint could not be examined beyond its abstract; an unindexed appendix might compute higher weights.
An earlier tabulation of this specific [64,10] code or a hidden equivalent duality computation may exist despite targeted searches.
The finite exact proof relies on complete enumeration; independent software and scientific audit have not been performed.

value.rationale: The 2015 main results leave exactly two interior generalized Hamming weights for the smallest rectangular 2-by-3 binary affine Grassmann code. Filling these two positions yields the entire 10-step hierarchy of a natural classical code, and counting all minimizing subcodes quantifies the scarcity of optimum joint-support configurations. This is a motivated finite classification, not a routine variant or unproved generalization.
